# Symaira

> Symaira builds nine open-source, local-first tools for human-AI collaboration. Every tool works standalone, runs on your machine (no cloud requirement, zero telemetry), and ships a Model Context Protocol (MCP) interface where applicable. Developed in Germany by Daniel Justus with a GDPR-first approach. Licenses: Apache-2.0 (MIT for Symaira Terminal).

The name Symaira means: SYM = symbiosis, AI = artificial intelligence, RA = the new era. The product family focuses on secrets, identity, privacy, agent context, and safe, repeatable agent workflows — keeping humans in control while AI agents do the work.

Install (macOS/Linux via Homebrew): `brew tap danieljustus/tap`, then `brew install symvault symbrain symdesk symbrowse symcockpit symeraseme symvibe symfritz` and `brew install --cask symterminal`.

Note on history: several earlier standalone tools were consolidated into these nine in August 2026. symmemory, symskills and symguard now live inside Symaira Brain; symseek, symprint, symingest, symmeet, symrelate and symroom inside Symaira Desktop; symfetch inside Symaira Browse; symtune, symoperate and symscope inside Symaira Cockpit. Their repositories are archived.

## Security & Privacy Tools

- [Symaira Vault (symvault)](https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira-vault): Terminal-native, age-encrypted (X25519 + ChaCha20-Poly1305) password and secrets manager for developers and AI agents. Scoped MCP tokens instead of raw secret sharing, `symvault run` env injection, egress credential broker, TOTP, autotype, Git sync, native macOS client.
- [Symaira EraseMe (symeraseme)](https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira-eraseme): Plans, sends, tracks, and verifies data broker erasure campaigns. Curated registry of 1,279 brokers (EU, UK, US), automatic GDPR 30-day / CCPA 45-day deadline monitoring, web-form automation, LLM inbox triage, event-sourced audit trail.

## Context & Knowledge Tools

- [Symaira Brain (symbrain)](https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira-brain): Portable agent context layer. One MCP gateway exposing three state cores — semantic memory with entities and relations, the skill catalog, and vault credentials — with one profile per harness (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, opencode) deciding what each may see. Includes the symguard module for call-time policy enforcement, plus native SwiftUI apps for macOS and iOS.
- [Symaira Desktop (symdesk)](https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira-desktop): Local-first, agent-native workspace over a single plain-Markdown vault. Go core runs as CLI, MCP server, authenticated self-hosted document server, or OCR worker; native SwiftUI apps for macOS and iOS. Includes hybrid search (BM25 + vectors, RRF), OCR/document ingestion, Markdown-to-PDF via Typst, meeting capture, contact references, and a signed project journal. Composes symbrain, symbrowse and symvault at runtime and degrades gracefully without them.
- [Symaira Browse (symbrowse)](https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira-browse): The browser an agent can operate while a person takes over at any time. Chrome CDP engine for dynamic pages plus a static fetch engine for plain documents, stable element references, reusable flows, out-of-band handoff for 2FA/CAPTCHA/approvals, and token-budgeted Markdown output. CLI, MCP server, and daemon in one CGO-free binary.

## System & Workflow Tools (macOS focus)

- [Symaira Terminal](https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira-terminal): Native macOS terminal (Ghostty engine) for running multiple CLI coding agents in parallel — per-pane status rings, ACP support, Git worktree isolation, BYOK with keys in the Keychain. MIT.
- [Symaira Cockpit (symcockpit)](https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira-cockpit): One native macOS CLI and MCP server with three subcommands — `tune` (display, focus, energy and cooling profiles), `scope` (local ports, containers, MCP server inventory, free-port suggestions), and `operate` (GUI automation with screenshots, OCR, accessibility). Every command answers in structured JSON.
- [Symaira Vibecoder (symvibe)](https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira-vibecoder): Local graphical dashboard to design and run autonomous agent coding cycles via drag-and-drop, with per-category and per-step model selection, driving opencode headless.
- [Symaira Fritz (symfritz)](https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira-fritz): CLI and MCP server for AVM FRITZ!Box routers — network topology, host diagnosis, guest WLAN, Wake-on-LAN, DECT smart home switching via TR-064 and AHA-HTTP.
